dom:
- banner:
  - strong: 算法工作台
  - text: 开发验证原型
  - paragraph: 粘贴代码，带着输入运行，在暂停处排错。
  - button "校验本地资源" [disabled]
  - status: 本机资源已校验 · 完整离线状态待集成验收
- text: iPad 离线冷启动待验证 · 当前工具链 Clang 8.0.1 / wasm32 ·
- link "原型说明与验证步骤":
  - /url: ./README.md
- navigation "运行与调试":
  - combobox "语言":
    - option "C++17" [selected]
    - option "C11"
  - button "编译运行" [disabled]
  - button "编译调试" [disabled]
  - button "继续"
  - button "进入"
  - button "跳过"
  - button "跳出"
  - button "停止"
  - status: 已暂停 · main.cpp:4:1
- main:
  - region "源码编辑":
    - button "粘贴代码"
    - button "复制题站源码"
    - button "导入"
    - combobox "导出内容":
      - option "仅题站源码" [selected]
      - option "完整草稿"
    - button "导出"
    - button "题站源码" [pressed]
    - button "测试驱动"
    - button "返回编辑稿" [pressed]
    - generic: main.cpp
    - generic: 调试快照 · 只读
    - generic "行号与断点":
      - button "1" [disabled]
      - button "2" [disabled]
      - button "3" [disabled]
      - button "4" [disabled]
      - button "5" [disabled]
      - button "6" [disabled]
      - button "7" [disabled]
      - button "8" [disabled]
    - text: "int main() { int total = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {"
    - generic: total += i;
    - text: "} return total; }"
    - textbox "源代码": "int main() { int total = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) { total += i; } return total; }"
    - button "在当前行切换断点" [disabled]
    - button "缩进" [disabled]
    - button "取消缩进" [disabled]
    - searchbox "查找源码"
    - button "下一处"
    - status: 草稿已保存 · 版本 17
    - generic "断点与编译诊断"
    - generic: 尚未设置断点。点击行号，或使用“在当前行切换断点”。
    - generic: 暂无编译诊断
  - complementary "输入输出与调试面板":
    - heading "样例输入 运行前一次性提供" [level=2]
    - textbox "标准输入":
      - /placeholder: 在这里粘贴输入样例
    - heading "程序输出" [level=2]: 程序输出
    - generic "程序输出": 尚无输出
    - heading "调用栈" [level=2]
    - button "main · main.cpp:4:1" [pressed]
    - button "main · 未提供源码位置"
    - button "_start · 未提供源码位置"
    - heading "局部变量" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - code: total
      - emphasis: int
      - text: "0"
    - paragraph:
      - code: i
      - emphasis: int
      - text: "1"
    - heading "基础监视" [level=2]
    - textbox "监视表达式":
      - /placeholder: 如 values[0] 或 total
    - button "查看"
    - paragraph: 支持范围以适配器为准；函数调用、赋值和自增不可用。
    - generic: 选择暂停栈帧后查询
